item.elsewhere.court_ashgrove_longbow.de: Mark: target glows for 6 s and takes +15% damage.
Rally: -10% damage taken, +1% per Lord Seal (max 15%).
item.elsewhere.court_duelists_sabre.desc: Parry: 8-tick window, 2.5 s cooldown, then Strength I for 3 s.
item.elsewhere.court_sovereigns_standard: Plant it to raise Regeneration I for allies within 16 blocks.
message.elsewhere.court_decree_silence: Decree of Silence: the realm is hushed.
message.elsewhere.court_decree_silence_a: The King's silence holds: no decrees this hour.
message.elsewhere.court_decree_summons: Decree of Summons: the Lords call their guard.
message.elsewhere.court_decree_tithe: Decree of Tithe: your purse answers to the Crown.
message.elsewhere.court_fallen: Aldermark has fallen. Its court is no more.
message.elsewhere.court_horns: The court horns sound across the realm.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_arm_ring.desc1: Given by the Jarl for deeds: 5 deeds earn one.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_arm_ring.desc2: Top-tier goods cost rings only. Carrying one takes 10 percent off every price.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_arm_ring.desc3: The Smith cuts a ring into 8 Hacksilver.
item.elsewhere.azmar_commission_slip.des: Half paid at the Royal Workshop.
Collect the masterwork after 3 days and pay the rest.
item.elsewhere.azmar_letter_of_credit.de: Dinars on deposit at every Azmar treasury, safe if you die.
Use it to read your balance.
item.elsewhere.mirewick_loan_note.desc1: A Counting-House loan: 25 percent interest, due in 7 days.
item.elsewhere.mirewick_loan_note.desc2: Overdue, Marrow's debt-collectors come for you inside Mirewick's realm.
gui.elsewhere.trader.title: %s of %s
gui.elsewhere.standing.label: Standing:
gui.elsewhere.standing.motto.hrafnholt: The sea gives; the ring-giver shares.
gui.elsewhere.standing.motto.azmar: Under one sun, by the Sultana's peace.
gui.elsewhere.standing.motto.mirewick: Every lantern lit, every ledger balanced.
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.lawspeaker.ho: “Your name is spoken at the Thing, and not kindly. Begone before the law finds its axe.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.lawspeaker.wa: “Speak plainly, outlander. The law hears every word, and it remembers.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.lawspeaker.ne: “Sit, guest. The Thing gathers on its days, and the law is the same for all who come in peace.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.lawspeaker.fr: “Shield-friend! Your deeds were told at the last Thing. Rings wait for those who earn them.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.lawspeaker.al: “Oath-kin, the hall is yours. Speak, and the Lawspeaker will remember it word for word.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.royal_envoy.h: “The Sultana's door is shut to you. Leave her lands while the sand still forgives.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.royal_envoy.w: “You are watched, stranger. Mind your manners in the Sultana's shade.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.royal_envoy.n: “Peace upon you, traveller. The treasury keeps your coin as safely as the river keeps its banks.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.royal_envoy.f: “Honoured guest, sit in the shade. The Sultana hears good things of you.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.royal_envoy.a: “Friend of the Throne! Ask, and the Sultanate will not be slow to answer.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.clerk.hostile: “Your account is closed and your name is in the red book. The Counting-House does not deal with defaulters.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.clerk.wary: “Cash on the counter, if you please. Your credit here is thin as fen ice.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.clerk.neutral: “Welcome to the Counting-House. Prices float, the ledger never lies, and everything is negotiable.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.clerk.friendl: “Ah, a valued client! The good ink comes out for you.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.clerk.allied: “Partner! The House drinks to your health. Sit, and let us talk of profit.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.smith.hostile: “My hammer has better work than you. Out of my forge.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.smith.wary: “Silver first, outlander. Then we will talk about steel.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.smith.neutral: “The forge never sleeps, Thing-day or no. What needs mending?”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.smith.friendl: “Shield-friend! Bring me your notched blades and I will make them sing again.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.smith.allied: “Oath-kin, for you the best iron and the hottest fire.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.market_inspec: “You are barred from the market by order of the Sultana. Go.”
“Every weight here is checked twice, and so are you.”
“Posted prices, honest weights, no haggling. The common stalls are open to you.”
“Honoured guest, the workshops open their doors to you. Their prices are posted, as always.”
“Friend of the Throne, the royal stock is yours to choose from, and to commission.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.auctioneer.ho: “No paddle for you, defaulter. The hammer falls without you.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.auctioneer.wa: “You may watch and you may bid, but the House remembers who pays.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.auctioneer.ne: “Lots at midday, the bell within the hour. Bid high, bid often!”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.auctioneer.fr: “A valued bidder returns! The best lots go to those who dare.”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.auctioneer.al: “Partner, the front row is yours. Shall we begin the bidding?”
gui.elsewhere.trader.greet.caravan_maste: “Stand off from my camels, or my guards will see you off.”
“We have come far and we trust slowly. Look, but keep your hands where I can see them.”
“Rare goods from beyond the dunes, this visit only. Choose well.”
“Honoured guest! Guard my caravan on the road, and the Sultanate pays its debts.”
“Friend of the Throne, the best of the road is yours. The camels know you by now.”
